display.purpose: The hero headline only, once per page. Never reused elsewhere — The Skinova Rule.

title.purpose: Sub-headings within a section: menu item names and prices.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy across the page, heavily letter-spaced (0.09em), never reduced.

label.purpose: Nav links, button labels, small controls.

shadows.name: button-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA hover only, paired with a 2px lift.

shadows.name: floating-menu-preview
shadows.purpose: The cursor-following product photo shown on menu item hover — the system's one true resting shadow, and it only exists while active.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Easing for ambient/reveal transitions (600-900ms) — hero badge spin, ticker, scroll reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main CTA pill (e.g. 'Découvrir'). Charcoal fill, white uppercase label, trailing arrow icon.
components.html: Découvrir
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #1F1A18; color: #fff; padding: 12px 27px 12px 36px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(35,20,9,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-arrow { display: inline-flex; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis CTA sitting beside the primary one (e.g. 'Nous trouver'). White fill, black label.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #fff; color: #000; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Category Tag
components.description: Small pill tag used sparingly for category/status labels — the system's one Wisteria Bloom UI moment.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #7047D7; color: #fff; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Playfair', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Menu Card
components.description: White container holding a menu category's item list. Flat, no resting shadow. Item names/prices use Espresso Brown/Dark Mocha, not Charcoal Brown.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-menu-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 15px; padding: 32px 28px; } .ds-menu-item { padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #E4D5CC; } .ds-menu-item-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-menu-item-name { font-family: 'Playfair', Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #4A352D; } .ds-menu-item-price { font-family: 'Playfair', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #4A352D; } .ds-menu-item-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #C88F86; letter-spacing: 0.09em; line-height: 1.37; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Fixed, transparent-over-hero nav that becomes solid Terracotta on scroll.
components.html: ConceptCarteEspace
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 22px 56px; background: transparent; } .ds-nav.scrolled { background: #B45F52; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 45px; } .ds-nav-links a { font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-mood-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 42px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); background: transparent; color: #fff; font-family: 'Playfair', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 220ms ease, border-color 220ms ease; } .ds-mood-toggle:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }

components.name: Menu Hover Preview
components.description: Signature component: a cursor-following floating photo revealed on menu item hover. The system's one genuine drop shadow.
components.css: .ds-menu-preview { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-menu-preview-inner { width: 260px; height: 300px; border-radius: 15px; overflow: hidden; background: #D8B8AE; box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(57,25,15,0.26); opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.94); transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-menu-preview.is-visible .ds-menu-preview-inner { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-menu-preview-inner img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }

narrative.overview:
Bloom Up is a collagen café and beauty bar in Mons' Grands Prés, built as the prototype for a future franchise network — brand decisions are made at that scale, not just for one site. The system reads as a physical extension of the product: soft, plump, nourishing shapes rendered in warm, sun-warmed color. Nothing has a sharp corner — buttons are full stadium pills, tags are rounded capsules, the hero's signature element is a literal spinning circle. Personality: chaleureuse mais affirmée, accessible mais jamais banale, photogénique mais sincère — a knowledgeable friend's voice, never an expert talking down or a shop pushing a sale.

The palette is warm and disciplined: Terracotta Bold is a full-bleed surface color used exactly twice per page — hero and footer, bookending everything between them — never a button or link. Wisteria Bloom (Electric Violet) is a single rare accent, at most one badge per section, never a background. A six-hue complementary family exists for the brand at large — on the website they stay accent-only and under 2% of any page, but on other channels (print, merchandising, social) any one of them can become a full surface color.
keyCharacteristics: Full stadium-pill buttons and tags; nothing sharp-cornered anywhere except the 2px keyboard-focus outline.
Terracotta Bold is a bookend surface color (hero + footer only, exactly twice per page) — never a button, link, or repeated section fill.
Flat by default — shadow appears only as a direct response to hover or a floating interaction, never as ambient card elevation.
Three-family type system: Skinova for the hero headline only, Playfair for every other heading/label, Source Sans 3 for body copy, all heavily tracked.
No page repeats a background color three sections in a row, and a secondary tone (Soft Nude, Rose Clay) appears at most once per page.

rules.name: The Neutral-Action Rule
rules.body: Every interactive control is rendered in Charcoal Brown (or white on a dark surface), never in Terracotta, Wisteria Bloom, or any complementary hue.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Wisteria Bloom and the complementary family appear in at most one or two elements per section and never as a section background or repeated UI fill.

rules.name: The Terracotta Bookend Rule
rules.body: Terracotta Bold is a full-bleed surface exactly twice per page — the hero and the footer — never a third time, and never a button or link color.

rules.name: The Two-Backgrounds Rule
rules.body: No page uses more than two background colors as full section fills at once (beyond the Terracotta bookends), always as flat blocks, and no color repeats for three consecutive sections.

rules.name: The Skinova Rule
rules.body: Skinova appears exactly once per page, on the hero headline only. It never sets a subheading, a label, or any other text.

rules.name: The Tracked-Type Rule
rules.body: Body and label text carry noticeably heavier letter-spacing (0.09em) than most web type, never reduced to save space.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadow is reserved strictly for direct-interaction feedback — never for passive elevation of a card, section, or badge. No backdrop-filter or blur anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Two-Radii Rule
rules.body: A new element's border-radius is either fully rounded (stadium/circle) or exactly 15px (containers/cards) — there is no third option.

dos: Do keep every button, tag, and small control fully rounded (stadium or circle), or exactly 15px for cards.
Do use Charcoal Brown (or white on a dark surface) for anything clickable.
Do carry heavy letter-spacing (0.09em) on body and label text, never reduced to save space.
Do reserve shadow for direct hover/interaction feedback only, never for resting elevation.
Do use Terracotta Bold only for the hero and footer — exactly twice per page.
donts: Don't give Terracotta Bold, Wisteria Bloom, or any complementary hue to a button, link, or other click target.
Don't repeat a background color three sections in a row, or use Soft Nude/Rose Clay more than once per page.
Don't add a resting shadow to a card, badge, or container to make it feel 'raised.'
Don't introduce a sharp or barely-rounded corner anywhere in the UI.
Don't use Skinova anywhere except the single hero headline.
Don't persist the mood-shuffle palette choice across visits — every fresh load starts on the default palette by design.
